description: This file defines a PHP interface 'ValueYNormalizable' within the OrangeHRM project, specifically in the namespace for report filter fields. The interface declares a method for normalizing the 'y' value of a selected filter field, intended for use by classes that handle report filtering and normalization processes.

classes.name: ValueYNormalizable
classes.description: An interface for classes that normalize the 'y' value of a selected filter field in report filters.

methods.name: toArrayYValue
methods.description: Returns the normalized 'y' value as an array or null.
